title: National Justice Agency List, 1985
description:
The National Justice Agency List, 1985 is a master name and
address file created and maintained by the Bureau of the Census for the
Bureau of Justice Statistics. The file contains information on the
following topics: prosecution and civil attorneys, public defenders,
law enforcement, courts, probation and parole, juvenile corrections,
local adult corrections, federal relations with American Indians, and
other justice issues.
